name: trogly
description: Trogly: talk to your RAID: Shadow Legends account in Claude Code. A fan project, not affiliated with Plarium.

plugins.name: trogly-core
plugins.description: Account access and memory: refresh from the running game, search champions and artifacts, see one champion's gear and calculated stats, plus goals, saved teams, saved loadouts, notes, and account history. The foundation the other Trogly plugins build on.

plugins.name: trogly-artifacts
plugins.description: Gear advice: the best artifacts for a champion from your own inventory under stat and set targets ("SPD 200+, then max ATK"), checked with exact stats. Installs trogly-core too.

plugins.name: trogly-knowledge
plugins.description: RAID facts from the game's own data: every champion's skills (cooldowns, buffs and debuffs), auras, and every stage's enemies, boss kits, and boss stat boosts, plus a speed tune simulator that plays out a team's turn order the way the game does. Installs trogly-core too.

plugins.name: trogly-dungeons
plugins.description: Dungeon team building from your own champions: reads the boss kit and boosts, works out what the fight needs, picks and explains a team. Installs trogly-core, trogly-knowledge, and trogly-artifacts too.

plugins.name: trogly-arena
plugins.description: Arena teams from your own champions: a Classic Arena team or three Tag Arena teams, with the leader's aura and the turn order (speed tune) checked against the game's rules. Installs trogly-core, trogly-knowledge, and trogly-artifacts too.
